notes: zlmlt.com is the Chinese-language global franchisor's corporate marketing site with no location-specific pricing anywhere on it. Filed instead from the restaurant's own DoorDash business storefront, which renders its full build-your-own hot-pot catalog as static text (100+ priced ingredient add-ins at $0.50-$5.50 each plus 6 base bowl-size prices); only a representative subset of add-ins is listed here.
